answer: During each epoch, participants broadcast a signed mesa-coordinate signal proving liveness and stake. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a verified off-chain reputation slot, binding wallet to person. Duplicate identities collapse onto the same mesa cell, so forging N sybils costs N distinct verified stakes plus recurring signal fees, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
